title: Concorde high back executive multi-tilter (2400-18)
body_html:
Presidential-grade executive seating — the chair Global built for the corner office and the 24-hour command post alike.

The Concorde 2400-18 High Back Executive Multi-Tilter is Global's dual-purpose flagship: refined enough for the boardroom in perforated leather with contrast stitching, tough enough for round-the-clock multi-shift use. Push-button arm controls put seat height and a 5-position tilt-lock at your fingertips, the multi-tilt mechanism is tested to 600,000 cycles, and it carries a 350 lb active weight capacity — built in Canada and backed by Global's Limited Lifetime Warranty.

Key features

  • Push-button armrest controls — seat height + 5-position tilt-lock
  • Multi-tilt mechanism tested to 600,000 cycles
  • 350 lb active weight capacity
  • Back/lumbar height and back-angle adjustment
  • Tilt-tension adjustment matched to body weight
  • Width-adjustable loop arms
  • Seat slider adjusts seat depth for leg length
  • 7-position back-height adjustment
  • Waterfall seat edge with contoured molded-foam cushions
  • Heavy-duty steel frame; reinforced base tested to 5,000 lbs; dual-wheel hooded casters

Who it's for

Executive offices, boardrooms, and 24/7 command environments that want presidential-grade leather comfort with heavy-duty, multi-shift durability and big-and-tall capacity.

Brant Business Interiors carries the Global Concorde 2400-18 and delivers across Ontario, with installation available. Call 1-800-835-9565 to confirm leather finishes, base options, and OECM pricing for your office.
